_note: The prepaid account holds $10. monthlyCapUsd is the hard stop, set below $10 so rounding and a price change cannot overrun it. shares split the month between jobs so whichever job runs first cannot eat the rest; they deliberately sum below the cap. estimateUsd is only the opening guess a guard uses before the ledger has seen that call — after a few real calls the observed mean replaces it. maxRunUsd catches a single run stuck in a retry loop.
